authors: I. Jack, D.R.T. Jones, A. Pickering
title: The connection between DRED and NSVZ
claim: The remaining coefficient rho_1 of the three-loop DRED->NSVZ coupling redefinition is fixed (rho_1 = 16/3) through a three-loop computation of the epsilon-scalar mass beta-function in the softly broken theory, completing the NSVZ/DRED connection through O(alpha^4) and thereby determining the four-loop DRED gauge beta-function; agreement with an earlier Pade-approximant prediction. Also introduces DRED' (soft scalar mass beta independent of the epsilon-scalar mass).
loop_order: redefinition to three loops; DRED gauge beta to four loops (inferred)
theory: general N=1 gauge theories, including soft SUSY breaking
scheme: DRED / DRED' with epsilon-scalars acquiring radiative masses (missed by naive spurion formalism).
symmetry_argument: Relations between soft-breaking beta-functions and the coupling redefinition; consistency of tensor structures T2, T3 used as checks.

proved: rho_1 = 16/3 from the epsilon-scalar mass beta (three-loop computation in the broken theory).
assumed: Four-loop DRED gauge beta follows from NSVZ + redefinition (i.e. assumes NSVZ holds in some scheme and DRED is a SUSY scheme related to it).
checked_partially: Consistency of the redefinition with soft scalar mass beta for alpha m^2 Y^2 Y*^2 C(R) terms; T2 and T3 structures give same rho_1.

evidence: Main text: determination of rho_1 = 16/3; DRED' definition; Pade comparison.
red_flags: The four-loop DRED gauge beta is not computed diagrammatically here; it is inferred assuming the NSVZ-DRED redefinition picture (direct check later: S1e.05_HJKMS2006, S1e.06_JJKM2007).
Epsilon-scalar masses are a genuine DRED artefact that must be tracked (DRED vs DRED').
notes: Journal ref not shown on the fetched page; PLB 435 (1998) 61 from memory.
